proposition: The Peri Council (via Azraq) has commissioned me to steal the spindle from Isle Jarrah.
quote: He named my task: "steal the spindle from Isle Jarrah."

proposition: The amulet affixed by Azraq enforces compliance and will punish resistance.
quote: When I tried to wrench it free, a hot spike flared under my ribs and something deep and old drew a line through my head. The pain was a command in another language.

proposition: Azraq said the Peri Council wants a single spindle.
quote: "The Council wants one thing," he said. "A single spindle."

proposition: Azraq said the Peri Council's reasons are urgent but opaque.
quote: "Our reasons are not for your keeping," he said. "They are urgent. You must understand urgency without understanding why."

proposition: Azraq said refusal will be answered by covenantal consequences and penalties.
quote: "Refusal will be answered," he said. "It will be answered by covenant. By consequence. By measures that make refusal a worse balance than acceptance."

proposition: Azraq asserted that the peri amulet is binding, enforces compliance, and has limits: it can be resisted by a strong mortal will, countered by witches' craft, or made irrelevant by using the Spindle under the island's terms.
quote: "Not none. Not absolute. The instrument we affix is a law, not a god. It can be resisted by a strong mortal will, it can be countered by the witches' craft, and it can be made irrelevant by what you seek—the Spindle—if used under the island's terms."

proposition: I accepted the Peri Council's commission under coercion and will keep command of the Qitaf and protect the crew.
quote: I told them plainly: I keep the Qitaf and my command. I will not send them to a death she did not need to take. I had told Azraq's envoy that his agents would keep their hands off the ship while she was mine. I meant it.

proposition: If we do this, we will do it in a way that keeps what cannot be replaced; we will not sacrifice the Qitaf or the crew for the Spindle.
quote: "If we do this," I said, and the map's paper scraped under my palm, "we do it because we have to, and because we will do it in a way that keeps what cannot be replaced. We bring the Spindle back if it lets us, but not at the cost of the Qitaf. Not at the cost of you lot down there."

proposition: The crew were informed of the mission and their faces showed fear and appetite.
quote: I called the crew up and told them what Azraq had said: we were bound to fetch the Spindle from Isle Jarrah.

proposition: The jagged fold in the water matched the torn diagram I'd smoothed from the wreck log.
quote: The jagged fold in the water matched the torn diagram I'd smoothed from the wreck log.

proposition: The folio's smudged crosses align with the sea folds we experienced; the little dark Xs fell under our course where the deck dipped.
quote: When he did, the smudged crosses fell under our course like a second chart: the little dark Xs lined where the sea folded, exactly where my hands felt the deck dip.
